reason: The Fannie Mae Conventional Properties Term Sheet explicitly caps LTV at 80% maximum. The requested 85% LTV exceeds this stated maximum, and no leverage exception is documented in the evidence packet. While the requested 1.30x DSCR does clear the 1.25x minimum, and the 50-unit stabilized multifamily meets the five-unit minimum and stabilization profile, the LTV overage alone puts the request outside the disclosed term-sheet parameters. The term sheet does not describe a general LTV exception pathway analogous to the case-by-case pre-stabilization consideration, so on the evidence provided this does not fit. Note the source also states guidelines do not establish approval of any specific borrower, so approval remains unverified regardless.
missing_information: Any documented Fannie Mae leverage exception or high-LTV program that would permit 85% LTV
